d: Why do cars in India cost almost double their factory price? Why are compact SUVs the most engineered product in Indian design history? And why is it easier to buy a Fortuner in Dubai than in India? In this video, we dive into India’s auto obsession—from towering taxes to cultural aspirations—to uncover the invisible systems shaping what we drive, how much we pay, and why a car here costs more than almost anywhere else in the world.
